description: Pattern: the person stops a running command and asks the next turn what happened to it (c26; Main's check-7w answer was "it cannot be confirmed whether it finished or was cut off"). EG-Desk stops the command itself (cancelRun), the engine never gets the tool result of an interrupted turn, so the runtime gives the NEXT turn the command fact (the command line, stopped at the person's request after N s, the signal, not completed) as EG-Desk context. The third turn must say it was stopped, not that it cannot be told: answerExcludes the Korean phrases for "cannot be confirmed / cannot be known" (확인할 수 없, 확인되지 않, 알 수 없). The command's own never-printed word is NOT excluded there: an answer may say that "cleanup-finished" was never printed (check-10s failed on exactly that quote, which was a correct statement); it stays excluded on turn 1, where nothing may be posted. Same flags and --decisions as real-engine-pause-v1. Expectations are code checks only.
